related_resources.reason: Emily Riehl, Category Theory in Context (2016)
Brendan Fong and David I. Spivak, Seven Sketches in Compositionality (2018)

description: Develops equalizers and pullbacks as universal compatibility problems, and pushouts and coequalizers as universal identifications. Uses cones and cocones to generalize to limits and colimits, explaining pullback pasting, construction from products and equalizers and their duals, and when functors preserve them.
